commit_title: Add Neutral morphology foundation and Creative testing controls (0.25.56)
summary: A usable first pass for all nine Neutral/Normal adult combinations, with the approved fixed head box and Hero Run path preserved, corrected Hero baby marker sampling, clear adult alignment locking, stage-safe Creative maturity editing and authorized named/nearest test commands.
limitations: The full Gradle build retains the two inherited triangle/trumpet transition failures (25/267696 and37/267696); it is not a green full-build claim.
The separate journal content suite retains its inherited Your gardens paragraph assertion (8/9).
Neutral forms are deliberately simplified first-pass blocky interpretations; original head boxes stay fixed. The report distinguishes actual viewer observations from authored approximations.

The old generic toy-model harnesses sample only the new fresh Neutral corner; true new all-combination pose/attachment checks and piano/organ contacts are separate. Actual broom/book/equipped samples are representative, not all-toys/all-forms verification.
The client runs the development classpath whose frozen production bytes are compared with the JAR. It is not claimed to have loaded the packaged JAR.
The motion movie is silent, uses accelerated training fixtures at native20TPS, and was reviewed through twelve decoded frames; no full interactive playback or listening claim.
Independent multiplayer, arbitrary shaders/full modpacks and native phone touch hardware remain unverified. Equipped client scenes show upright flight, not horizontal elytra or swimming.
